verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.201
21. A True Person
Training Rules
“Mendicants, I will teach you an untrue person and an even more untrue person,
a true person and an even truer person.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.
The Buddha said this:
“And what is an untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
verses.english: It’s someone who kills living creatures, steals, commits sexual misconduct, lies, and consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.
This is called an untrue person.
And what is an even more untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s someone who kills living creatures, steals, commits sexual misconduct, lies, and consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. And they encourage others to do these things.

verses.pali: attanā ca adinnādāyī hoti, parañca adinnādāne samādapeti;
attanā ca kāmesumicchācārī hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācāre samādapeti;
attanā ca musāvādī hoti, parañca musāvāde samādapeti;
attanā ca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti, parañca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāne samādapeti.

verses.english: This is called an even more untrue person.
And what is a true person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: It’s someone who doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.
This is called a true person.
And what is an even truer person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s someone who doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. And they encourage others to refrain from these things.

verses.pali: attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā ca kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā ca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.

verses.english: This is called an even truer person.”
